title: Compact-support exchange, finite coefficients
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and uniformizer $\varpi$, and an integer $n\geq1$, and write $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let
$$
\begin{array}{ccc}
X'&\xrightarrow{g'}&X\\
f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\
Y'&\xrightarrow{g}&Y
\end{array}
$$
be a Cartesian square of schemes [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Use the small pro-etale constant-$A$-module derived categories [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and their ordinary unbounded derived operations $Lu_A^*\dashv Ru_{*,A}$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]; thus $Lu_A^*=u^{-1}$ for these constant coefficients. Suppose a compactification $c_f=(j,p)$ of $f$ has been chosen: $j:X\hookrightarrow\overline X$ is open, $p:\overline X\to Y$ is proper, and $pj=f$. Let $c'=(j',p')$ be its base change, with $\bar g:\overline X'\to\overline X$ and Cartesian proper square $\square_p$, as in [pur713-def-base-changed-compactification]. Write $\mathrm D(j_{!,A})$ for termwise extension by zero on the derived categories, justified by the exactness of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero]: an exact functor applied termwise preserves quasi-isomorphisms and induces a functor on the derived categories represented by its termwise value [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]; similarly for $j'$. In this definition the chosen and auxiliary compact-support functors mean the explicit composites
$$
Rf_{!,A}:=Rp_{*,A}\mathrm D(j_{!,A}),\qquad
R_{c'}:=Rp'_{*,A}\mathrm D(j'_{!,A}).
$$
Both are functors on the full unbounded derived categories; these formulas make no compactification-independence assertion.

The finite-coefficient compact-support exchange

$$
\operatorname{Ex}_{!,\square,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}:
Lg^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}Rf_{!,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}
\longrightarrow R_{c'}Lg'^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n},
$$

a natural transformation of functors $D(X_{\Proet},\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)\to D(Y'_{\Proet},\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n)$ between the two composite functors just defined, has component at $K$ the composite

$$
\begin{aligned}
Lg^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}Rp_{*,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}\mathrm D(j_{!,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n})K
&\xrightarrow{\operatorname{Ex}_{*,\square_p,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}}Rp'_{*,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}L\bar g^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}\mathrm D(j_{!,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n})K\\
&\xrightarrow{Rp'_{*,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}(b_{j,\bar g,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n,K})}
Rp'_{*,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}\mathrm D(j'_{!,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n})Lg'^*_{\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}K,
\end{aligned}
$$

with $\operatorname{Ex}_{*,\square_p,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}$ of Definition [pur713-def-star-exchange] for the square $\square_p$ and
$$
b_{j,\bar g,A,K}:L\bar g_A^*\mathrm D(j_{!,A})K\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathrm D(j'_{!,A})Lg'^*_AK
$$
the canonical natural pro-etale open-extension base-change isomorphism of complexes of [lem-cbc-proetale-extension-zero-base-change], using $Lu_A^*=u^{-1}$, read on the derived categories: all four functors $\bar g^{-1},j_!,j'_!,g'^{-1}$ are exact and applied termwise, so by [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization] both composites are computed by their termwise values and the natural isomorphism of complexes gives the displayed natural isomorphism. Its target is formed with the base-changed compactification $c'$, which in general differs from $c_{f'}$; passing to $Rf'_{!,\mathcal O_E/\varpi^n}=R_{c_{f'}}$ requires a separately supplied natural comparison $R_{c'}\cong R_{c_{f'}}$. This definition does not supply that comparison or assert that the displayed exchange is invertible.
